item.title: Humid 1.0: React server-side rendering in Rails can be easy!
item.content:encoded: We're releasing Humid 1.0. A few helper methods to help with React server-side rendering in Rails with mini_racer.

item.title: A prototype is not a product. It's a conversation.
item.content:encoded: Most organizations prototype too late. The best prototypes aren't built to validate software, they're built to create alignment. Especially in regulated industries, a prototype is the fastest way to replace assumptions with evidence and make better decisions.

item.title: New: The State of Software Delivery in Healthcare
item.content:encoded: 168 healthcare tech leaders were surveyed on software delivery. 68% say speed and risk are in constant tension. We broke down what's really behind it and what separates innovative teams from the rest.
